audit_item: A13/A14 / Stage58-60 and M3.3 evidence analyzer JSON integrity
finding: Four still-callable M3 coverage and action-value analyzers used default JSON decoding for preregistrations, frozen configurations, R1 learning reports, completion receipts, and native action-value reports. Duplicate keys could replace identity or diagnostic counters while leaving the raw file SHA unchanged from its paired marker.
change: The Stage58, Stage59, Stage60, and M3.3 analyzer readers now use rles_data.loads_unique_json, reject duplicate keys recursively, normalize IO/UTF-8/JSON errors to ValueError, and require object roots. Added temporary-file tests for duplicate keys, invalid UTF-8, and non-object roots through every reader.
